observations: Photo 0 shows a disassembled car engine bay/engine assembly on the ground with many hoses/wiring harnesses removed or loose.

identity.kind: used car engine assembly (exact model not readable)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable engine code/label or LX460-specific identification.

risks.risk: Exact engine identification is unclear (could be a different Lexus/Toyota engine or incomplete variant), which changes compatibility and value.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate (usually stamped on the engine block or on a label) and the intake/manifold label if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified used Toyota/Lexus engine assembly with unknown variant (worst case: not guaranteed to match LX460).

risks.risk: Engine completeness is uncertain (missing parts, sensors, alternator/AC compressor, coils, wiring connectors).
risks.proof: Ask for a full set of photos showing: (1) both sides of the engine, (2) all accessories laid out, (3) a checklist of included parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: missing key sensors/accessories).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (could be seized, cracked, or damaged during removal).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of a cold start/test run (or at least compression test results) and/or proof it was running before removal.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Transmission/ECU/immobilizer compatibility not shown (if buyer expects full setup).
risks.proof: Ask whether ECU, harness, starter, alternator, and any immobilizer components are included; request photos of ECU and harness connectors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only without guaranteed ECU/harness/immobilizer matching.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate stamped on the block (and any label on the intake/cover) to confirm LX460 engine variant.
Photos of the engine from multiple angles showing all ports and accessories to confirm completeness (and what is missing).
Video proof of running/test (or compression/leak-down results) before removal.
List of included items (engine only vs engine + ECU + harness + starter/alternator + sensors) with photos of ECU and harness connectors.
response.reason: The photo does not clearly confirm the exact Lexus LX460 engine variant, completeness, or working condition—without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the provided comparables.
